record.paper_title: Some Open Problems on Multiple Ergodic Averages
record.original_question: Let (X, X, μ, T_n) be a measure-preserving system with multiplicative structure, meaning T_m ∘ T_n = T_{mn}. For every measurable A with μ(A) > 0, must there exist m, n ∈ N such that μ(T_{m(m+n)}A ∩ T_{(m+2n)(m+3n)}A ∩ T_{(m+4n)(m+5n)}A) > 0?

evidence.quote: Problem 35. Let (X, X , µ, Tn) be a measure preserving system with multiplicative structure and A ∈ X with µ(A) > 0. Is it true that there exist m, n ∈ N such that µ(Tm(m+n)A ∩ T(m+2n)(m+3n) ∩ T(m+4n)(m+5n)A) > 0 ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Call a quadruple $(X,\mathcal{X},\mu,(T_n)_{n\in\mathbb{N}})$ a measure-preserving system with multiplicative structure if $(X,\mathcal{X},\mu)$ is a probability space and each $T_n\colon X\to X$ is a measurable, measure-preserving transformation satisfying the multiplicative composition rule
$$T_m\circ T_n = T_{mn}\qquad\text{for all }m,n\in\mathbb{N}.$$
Question: Does it hold that for every such system and every $A\in\mathcal{X}$ with $\mu(A)>0$ there exist positive integers $m,n\in\mathbb{N}$ such that
$$\mu\!\left(T_{m(m+n)}A\;\cap\;T_{(m+2n)(m+3n)}A\;\cap\;T_{(m+4n)(m+5n)}A\right)>0\ ?$$
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work by Frantzikinakis and collaborators (2023–2025) on multiplicative measure-preserving actions establishes multiple recurrence/convergence in various cases related to partition regularity of homogeneous quadratic forms, but the specific triple-intersection question along the iterates $m(m+n)$, $(m+2n)(m+3n)$, $(m+4n)(m+5n)$ does not appear to be resolved in the available literature. It is still listed among open problems on multiple ergodic averages.

status_evidence.title: Multiple recurrence and convergence without commutativity
status_evidence.snippet: Multiple recurrence and convergence results for multiplicative measure preserving actions with iterates given by rational sequences.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress on multiplicative-action recurrence problems but not this specific triple.

status_evidence.title: Decomposition results for multiplicative actions and applications
status_evidence.snippet: Decomposition results for multiplicative measure-preserving systems used to attack partition regularity problems.
status_evidence.claim: Active research direction; specific configuration remains an open problem.
